note: 店长手写层。此文件覆盖同 id 抓取项的任意字段；每次 feed 重建时合并，scout 永远不会覆盖这里的内容。

juliusbrussee-caveman-caveman.tagline_zh: 让 Claude 像原始人一样说话：「为什么用很多 token，少 token 就行」。据称省 65% token，还越用越上头。
juliusbrussee-caveman-caveman.tagline_en: Makes Claude talk like a caveman. "Why use many token when few token do trick." Cuts ~65% of tokens, weirdly addictive.
juliusbrussee-caveman-caveman.why_zh: 这是整个 Skill 生态里最好笑的一个创意，而且它居然真的有用——省 token 是刚需，用原始人语气省 token 是行为艺术。
juliusbrussee-caveman-caveman.why_en: The funniest idea in the whole skills ecosystem — and it genuinely works. Saving tokens is a real need; doing it in caveman grunts is performance art.

worldwonderer-novel-to-game-novel-to-gam.tagline_zh: 喂给它一本小说，它按原著设定拆世界观、出美术方向、直接把游戏做出来——真的能玩。
worldwonderer-novel-to-game-novel-to-gam.tagline_en: Feed it a novel; it extracts the world, art-directs it, and builds a genuinely playable game grounded in the source text.
worldwonderer-novel-to-game-novel-to-gam.why_zh: 「把喜欢的小说做成能玩的游戏」是很多人的童年梦想，这个 skill 把整条流水线打包好了，交给 Claude Code 就能开工。
worldwonderer-novel-to-game-novel-to-gam.why_en: Turning a beloved book into a playable game is a childhood dream for a lot of people — this packages the whole pipeline so Claude Code can just get to work.

worldwonderer-oh-story-claudecode.tagline_zh: 扫榜、拆文、长篇短篇写作、去 AI 味、封面图——网络小说从选题到上架的全流程 13 件套。
worldwonderer-oh-story-claudecode.tagline_en: A 13-piece kit for Chinese web fiction: chart-scanning, story deconstruction, long/short-form writing, de-AI-flavoring, and cover art.
worldwonderer-oh-story-claudecode.why_zh: 中文互联网最生猛的 skill 包之一：不是教你写作，是直接把网文工业流水线搬进 Claude Code。
worldwonderer-oh-story-claudecode.why_en: One of the most ambitious skill packs out of the Chinese internet — it doesn't teach writing, it installs the entire web-fiction production line.

alchaincyf-huashu-design.tagline_zh: 花叔出品的 HTML 原生设计 skill：高保真原型、幻灯片、动画，附赠 20 条设计哲学。
alchaincyf-huashu-design.tagline_en: Huashu's HTML-native design skill for Claude Code: hi-fi prototypes, slides, and animation, shipped with 20 design philosophies.
alchaincyf-huashu-design.why_zh: 中文社区口碑最好的设计 skill。它不只给样式，还给审美立场——这正是大部分 AI 生成页面缺的东西。
alchaincyf-huashu-design.why_en: The best-loved design skill in the Chinese community. It ships a point of view, not just styles — exactly what most AI-generated pages lack.

anthropics-skills-algorithmic-art.tagline_zh: 官方出品：用 p5.js 玩生成艺术——流场、粒子、噪声，说一句「来点赛博山水」就能出图。
anthropics-skills-algorithmic-art.tagline_en: Official Anthropic skill: generative art with p5.js — flow fields, particles, noise seeds. Say "cyber landscape" and watch it draw.
anthropics-skills-algorithmic-art.why_zh: 官方技能里最好玩的一个，零门槛体验「让 AI 画画」的正确姿势。
anthropics-skills-algorithmic-art.why_en: The most playful of the official skills — the zero-friction way to experience AI making art properly.

anthropics-skills-slack-gif-creator.tagline_zh: 官方出品：给 Slack 做会动的 emoji 和 GIF 表情包，摸鱼刚需。
anthropics-skills-slack-gif-creator.tagline_en: Official skill for making animated emoji and GIFs sized for Slack. Essential workplace mischief.

leonxlnx-taste-skill.tagline_zh: 一整套「给 AI 好品味」的 skill：前端设计品味、品牌套件、截图转代码，专治千篇一律的 AI 塑料感。
leonxlnx-taste-skill.tagline_en: A pack that gives your AI taste: frontend design taste, brand kits, image-to-code — the antidote to generic AI slop.
leonxlnx-taste-skill.why_zh: 73k 星不是白来的：它解决的是所有人都在骂但很少有人动手修的问题——AI 产出的「塑料感」。
leonxlnx-taste-skill.why_en: 73k stars for a reason: it attacks the thing everyone complains about but few actually fix — the plastic feel of AI output.

blader-humanizer.tagline_zh: 把文字里的 AI 痕迹擦掉：破折号癖、排比强迫症、「值得注意的是」……一键人味回归。
blader-humanizer.tagline_en: Scrubs the tells of AI writing — em-dash addiction, triplet lists, "it's worth noting" — until the text reads human again.
blader-humanizer.why_zh: 可能是被转发最多的单体 skill：谁都需要，装完就懂。
blader-humanizer.why_en: Possibly the most-shared single skill out there. Everyone needs it; you get it the moment you install it.

aldegad-sprite-gen.tagline_zh: 生成干净的 2D 游戏精灵图和动画图集：状态行、透明清理、逐帧拆分，独立游戏人狂喜。
aldegad-sprite-gen.tagline_en: Clean 2D game sprites and animation atlases — state rows, alpha cleanup, frame extraction. Indie devs rejoice.
aldegad-sprite-gen.why_zh: 游戏素材是独立开发最大的坑之一，这个 skill 把「画小人」变成了一句话的事。
aldegad-sprite-gen.why_en: Art assets are one of the biggest walls in indie game dev; this turns "draw me a sprite sheet" into a one-liner.

vincentwei1021-video-shotcraft.tagline_zh: 用 Remotion 拍电影感产品视频：106 张分镜配方卡、161 个运镜预设，一句话出片。
vincentwei1021-video-shotcraft.tagline_en: Cinematic product videos with Remotion: 106 shot recipe cards and 161 motion presets. One prompt, one film.
vincentwei1021-video-shotcraft.why_zh: 把「拍产品宣传片」这种要外包的活变成了本地技能，分镜卡的设计尤其讲究。
vincentwei1021-video-shotcraft.why_en: Turns "hire a studio for the launch video" into a local skill — the shot recipe cards are unusually well crafted.

dietrichgebert-ponytail-ponytail.tagline_zh: 让你的 AI 像组里最懒的资深工程师一样思考：最好的代码是不写的代码。写之前先问三遍「真的需要吗」。
dietrichgebert-ponytail-ponytail.tagline_en: Makes your agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room: the best code is the code you never wrote.
dietrichgebert-ponytail-ponytail.why_zh: 表面是个梗，内核是严肃的工程哲学——它拦下来的过度设计，比很多 lint 规则都多。
dietrichgebert-ponytail-ponytail.why_en: A joke on the surface, serious engineering philosophy underneath — it prevents more over-engineering than most lint rules.

ayghri-i-have-adhd-i-have-adhd.tagline_zh: ADHD 友好输出：不许把答案埋在第八段，先说结论，短句，重点前置。
ayghri-i-have-adhd-i-have-adhd.tagline_en: ADHD-friendly output: stop burying the answer in paragraph eight. Conclusion first, short lines, signal up front.

tracywang95-anythingbutlaw.tagline_zh: 给律师的「法律之外」技能包：决策分析、博弈论、合同设计等 9 个分析框架。名字就赢了。
tracywang95-anythingbutlaw.tagline_en: "Anything But Law" — nine non-legal frameworks for lawyers: decision analysis, game theory, contract design. The name alone earns shelf space.

jimliu-baoyu-skills.tagline_zh: 宝玉老师的 22 件套：翻译、画图、漫画、播客、公众号总结……中文 AI 圈的经典工具箱。
jimliu-baoyu-skills.tagline_en: Baoyu's 22-piece kit: translation, diagrams, comics, podcast tools, WeChat digests — a classic toolbox from the Chinese AI community.

jimliu-baoyu-skills-baoyu-comic.tagline_zh: 把一段故事或概念画成多格漫画，配文案带分镜，发朋友圈刚好。
jimliu-baoyu-skills-baoyu-comic.tagline_en: Turns a story or concept into a multi-panel comic with captions and layout — perfectly sized for social feeds.

jimliu-baoyu-skills-baoyu-diagram.tagline_zh: 长文秒变信息图解：结构、流程、关系一图讲清，公众号配图神器。
jimliu-baoyu-skills-baoyu-diagram.tagline_en: Long text to explainer diagram in seconds — structure, flow, and relations in one picture.

jimliu-baoyu-skills-baoyu-image-gen.tagline_zh: 按文章语义自动出配图 prompt 并生成插图，风格统一不跳戏。
jimliu-baoyu-skills-baoyu-image-gen.tagline_en: Generates on-brand illustrations from the article's meaning — consistent style, no visual whiplash.

anthropics-skills-canvas-design.tagline_zh: 官方设计技能：海报、封面、社交卡片，直接在画布上排版出图。
anthropics-skills-canvas-design.tagline_en: Official design skill: posters, covers, and social cards, composed and rendered on a real canvas.

anthropics-skills-frontend-design.tagline_en: Anthropic's frontend taste guide: anti-template, anti-default. This very store was built on its advice.

anthropics-skills-docx.tagline_en: The official Word skill: TOCs, page numbers, comments, tracked changes — .docx you can actually hand in.
